The FloPlast push-fit air admittance valve is an essential component for efficient soil and vent drainage systems, preventing odours. This durable uPVC air admittance valve features a 110mm push-fit connection for quick and secure installation, making it suitable for both domestic and commercial plumbing projects. An integrated mesh allows for external fitting, enhancing installation flexibility. With an air flow capacity of 30.8 Ltr/sec, this black valve efficiently regulates pressure. Its demountable and reusable design further assists with ongoing maintenance and system adjustments for trade professionals.
